THE CONCEPT

A Najafgarh craving.
A little extra butter.

A restaurant website concept inspired by Rao Butter Momos / राव बटर मोमोज. From steam butter to Afghani malai and tandoori masala, explore a world of momos right here in Najafgarh.

Bring your appetite. Pick your flavour. Round it out with noodles, rice or your favourite Chinese sides, and try a sample takeaway request in the demo bag.

A few things before you order

How do I place an order?

Add dishes to your bag, review your takeaway request and preview a sample message. This demo prepares a sample message only; it does not send orders to the restaurant.

Can I get delivery?

This concept website does not accept takeaway or delivery requests. Contact the restaurant to ask about delivery availability and policies, or check the linked platforms.

Can I choose a pickup time?

Yes. Add your preferred time at checkout. It is subject to confirmation by the restaurant.

How are veg and non-veg items marked?

A green dot inside a green square marks vegetarian items, including paneer. A red dot inside a red square marks chicken and egg. The marker and text change when you select a variant.
